note: The loss in [L] is `surcharges`, the product of `R_i^(-ε)` over all scales, while [M] keeps only `rho_min^(-tau)`; since every `R_i <= 1` the Lean bound is larger, so [M]'s displayed bounds are stronger. Convergence is along an ultrafilter rather than a subsequence.

proof_context.conclusion: A projected degree-`w` row of a `Ticket` expression is bounded by `c*(p*R_i^w)*surcharges R t ε`.

snippet.text: lemma price : ∃ c>(0:ℝ),∀ t ∈ U,∀ i : Viewers Z, ‖readExpr M.basis (spectator Z i) (e t)‖ ≤ c * p t * surcharges R t ε := by

proof_context.conclusion: Any `Ticket` expression is bounded by `c * p * surcharges R t ε` uniformly on `U`, where the `residual` constructor carries the gain `(R_i/R_j)^(w+1)`.

snippet.text:
inductive Ticket (Z : Final C F S) (M : Devices Z.sector.derivatives) (R : I → W→ℝ) (U : Set W) :
    (A : Set (W → E4)) → I → (W → ℝ) → (W → Expression Z.sector.derivatives) → Prop where
  | leaf {A d i} (x : W→ E4) (p : W→ S.Field d) (hx : x∈ A) (h : ∃ P : ℝ,∀ t∈U, ‖p t‖ ≤ P) :
      Ticket Z M R U A i (fun t=> R i t ^ (-(d:ℝ))) (fun t=> insertField M.basis (x t) d (p t))
  | unit {A i} : Ticket Z M R U A i 1 1
  | times {A B i p q e f} : Ticket Z M R U A i p e → Ticket Z M R U B i q f → Separate U A B (R i) → Ticket Z M R U (A∪ B) i (p*q) (e*f)
  | carry {A i p e j} (h : Ticket Z M R U A i p e) (x : W→ E4) (hx : x∈A) (hp : Inspect U (R i) x A) (hs : Small U (R i) (R j)) : Ticket Z M R U A j p e
  -- can be used also inside other nodes: ratio gain on EACH such step in the physical weight
  | residual {A i p e j} (h : Ticket Z M R U A i p e) (x : W→ E4) (w : ℕ) (hx : x∈A) (hp : Inspect U (R i) x A) (hs : Small U (R i) (R j)) (hw : Window M U w x A) : Ticket Z M R U A j (fun t=> p t*((R i t / R j t)^(w+1:ℝ))) (e-statedProject M w x e)
  -- no ratio smallness here (important for tails)
  | project {A i p e j} (h : Ticket Z M R U A i p e) (x : W→ E4) (w : ℕ) (hx : x∈A) (hp : Inspect U (R i) x A) (hw : Window M U w x A) : Ticket Z M R U {x} j
          (fun t=> p t*((R i t / R j t)^(w:ℝ))) (fun t=> M.insertRow (x t) w (e t))
  | widen {A B i p e} (h : Ticket Z M R U A i p e) (hp : A ⊆ B) : Ticket Z M R U B i p e

proof_context.conclusion: The `leaf` weight `R^(-d)`, and the `project` and `residual` weights `(R_i/R_j)^w` and `(R_i/R_j)^(w+1)`, carry the child size factor and the row and residual rates.

let Ω:= Ultrafilter.of (atTop:Filter ℕ); let φ : Filter ℕ:= Ω
  haveI hN: NeBot φ:= by change NeBot (Ω:Filter ℕ); infer_instance
  have hT: Tendsto T φ atTop:= (tendsto_atTop_mono ht tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).mono_left (Ultrafilter.of_le _)
  have hratio (f : ℕ→ℝ)(h0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (hh : ∀ i, f i ≤ T i) : ∃ s∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,Tendsto (fun i=> f i/T i) φ (𝓝 s):= by
    let g i:=f i/T i
    have hG : ∀ᶠ i in φ, g i ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1:= by filter_upwards [hT.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with i hi using ⟨div_nonneg (h0 _) hi.le,(div_le_one hi).mpr (hh i)⟩
    apply isCompact_Icc.ultrafilter_le_nhds (Ω.map g) ?_; refine le_principal_iff.mpr ?_; exact hG
  choose s hs hx using fun i:I=> hratio (fun j=>p j i) (hp i) (fun j=> le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _=>hp i j) (Finset.mem_univ i)) (le_add_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg j)))
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hK⟩:=hratio _ Nat.cast_nonneg ht
  have hw(i:I):RateIs φ T (R i ∘ f) (-(s i)):= ⟨Eventually.of_forall fun j=> (hr _ (hu j) i).1,
    (hx i|>.neg).congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun j=> by dsimp [p]; rw [neg_div,neg_neg])⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Along an ultrafilter the heights `p/T` converge in `[0,1]`, giving `Ride` data.
